question: Zoho Member Technical Staff, Round 4 (in-depth technical discussion, about 1 hour). Topics covered: **multithreading, streams in Java, REST APIs and Spring Boot**. Problem solving: **compute all the divisors of a number in O(sqrt(N)) time using Java streams.** The round also included numerical problems on processor allocation time.
lookingFor: Fluency with Java streams (IntStream, filter, flatMap, collect).
Breadth in multithreading, REST and Spring Boot fundamentals.
followUps: How would you find only the prime divisors?
What is the difference between map and flatMap?
When is a parallel stream a bad idea?
What makes a REST API idempotent and which HTTP methods are idempotent?
How does Spring Boot's dependency injection work?
